title: dolia crassulifolia

This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its therapeutic properties and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Dolia crassulifolia include furanocoumarins, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects.
